installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Server Files: /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

REPO="tiltedphoques/TiltedEvolution"
ASSET_PREFIX="SkyrimTogetherServer"
TMP_DIR="/tmp/stserver"

DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sSL "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r --arg PREFIX "$ASSET_PREFIX" '.assets[] | select(.name | test($PREFIX + ".*linux.*amd64"; "i")) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)

if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ] || [ "$DOWNLOAD_URL" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Asset with prefix $ASSET_PREFIX not found"
    exit 1
fi

ASSET_NAME=$(basename "$DOWNLOAD_URL")

mkdir -p "$TMP_DIR"

curl -sSL -o "$TMP_DIR/$ASSET_NAME" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"
tar -xzf "$TMP_DIR/$ASSET_NAME" -C .
rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"

chmod +x SkyrimTogetherServer

echo -e "Install Complete"

variables.name: Gold Loss Factor
variables.description:
Used to determine how much gold a player loses when they die. When set to 0, players will not lose any gold.
This is a factor. It can be set to anything between 0 and 1. For example, if you want the player to lose 5% of its gold on death, set it to 0.05.

variables.name: Enable XP Sync
variables.description: Determines whether the xp sync system is enabled or not.

variables.name: Enable PVP
variables.description: Determines whether players can damage each other. Shouts on other players, like fus ro dah, also only work when this option is enabled.

variables.name: Enable Greetings
variables.description: In the base game, when you walk close to an NPC, they start talking to you with random dialogue. During testing, we found this to be quite annoying when dialogue sync was implemented. Therefore, we decided to disable those greetings. You can enable this again if you'd like through this setting.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: This sets the server side difficulty, which is enforced on all clients.

variables.name: Announce Server
variables.description: Determines whether the server shows up on the server list or not. If the server has a password, it will not show up on the server list.

variables.name: Allow MO2
variables.description: Sets whether the client is allowed to use mod organizer 2.

variables.name: Allow SKSE
variables.description: Sets whether the client is allowed to use SKSE.

variables.name: Enable Mod Check
variables.description: Enables the checking of mods on the server

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: This sets the password that players need to fill in when connecting to the server. Leave this blank if you do not want to set a password on the server. If you do set a password on the server, it will not show up in the serverlist, and people will have to connect manually.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name that shows up on the server list.

variables.name: Premium Mode
variables.description:
Determines the tickrate of the server. Most networks should be able to handle running a server with this option enabled.
True = 60 tickrate | False = 30 tickrate

variables.name: Enable ItemDrop Sync
variables.description: Disabling this will make it so that dropping items in the world is not synced. Dropping items has caused crashes in the past, and picking them up is often not synced anyway, so we recommend you keep it at the default, which is "off".

variables.name: Enable Misc Quest Sync
variables.description: (Experimental) By default, Skyrim Together syncs main quests and side quests, but not miscellaneous quests. Enabling this setting will attempt to sync misc quests as well.

variables.name: Auto Party Join
variables.description: Join parties automatically, as long as there is only one party in the server.

variables.name: Enable Calendar Sync
variables.description: Syncs up all player calendars to be the same day, month, and year. This uses the date of the player with the furthest ahead date at connection.

variables.name: Time Scale
variables.description: Determines how fast the time in Skyrim progresses.

variables.name: Enable Death System
variables.description: Determines whether the Skyrim Together Reborn custom death system is enabled. This should ONLY be turned off if you know what you're doing, and if you have a suitable death mod that replaces the mechanics. Reloading old saves every time you die will cause issues.

variables.name: Enable Player Home Sync
variables.description: Determines whether chests in player homes are synced. Beware that long term storage is not consistent in Skyrim. By default, this option is disabled so that players can use their homes to safely dump items in their chests as a form of long term storage.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Used for potential admin panels in the future. This option is currently unused.

variables.name: Max Player
variables.description:
The max number of players that can connect to your server.
Recommend that you play with 2 to 8 people for the best experience.
